sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: In the global fight to dominate AI, China is quickly catching up to the United States, which is why President Trump barred the tech giant NVIDIA
sentences.zh: 在全球争夺人工智能主导权的斗争中，中国正迅速赶上美国，这就是特朗普总统禁止科技巨头英伟达

sentences.en: from selling its super-powered computer chips to Chinese companies.
sentences.zh: 向中国公司出售其超高性能计算机芯片的原因。

sentences.en: Until, that is, a few days ago, when Trump abruptly reversed course.
sentences.zh: 直到几天前，特朗普突然改变了方针。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Tripp Mickel, on how NVIDIA's CEO persuaded Trump that the best way to beat China at AI is to help China to compete.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事特里普·米克尔将讲述英伟达首席执行官是如何说服特朗普的：在人工智能领域击败中国的最好方法，是帮助中国参与竞争。

sentences.en: Tuesday, July 22nd.
sentences.zh: 7月22日，星期二。

sentences.en: Well, Tripp, thank you for being here in person.
sentences.zh: 特里普，谢谢你亲自来到这里。

sentences.en: It's very exciting when you tech folks from the coast make your way here to New York.
sentences.zh: 你们这些来自西海岸的科技界人士来到纽约，真是令人兴奋。

sentences.en: Yeah, we come here to sweat.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我们来这里是为了流汗的。

sentences.en: We leave the cool air of San Francisco to sweat in New York for the summertime.
sentences.zh: 我们离开旧金山凉爽的空气，到纽约的夏天来流汗。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, I apologize for the weather here.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我为这里的天气道歉。

sentences.en: But nothing else.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，我没什么可道歉的。

sentences.en: So, as you know, we cover a lot of AI here on The Daily because its impact on everything grows day after day.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，我们在《每日新闻》中报道了大量人工智能相关内容，因为它对各方面的影响与日俱增。

sentences.en: And here in the United States, the idea is that to be number one at AI, we need to stay ahead of China, our number one adversary when it comes to AI.
sentences.zh: 在美国，人们认为要成为人工智能领域的头号强国，我们需要保持对中国的领先，因为中国是我们人工智能领域最大的竞争对手。

sentences.en: And that means restricting what American companies who hold the keys to AI's future can do in China.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要限制那些掌握人工智能未来关键的美国公司在中国开展业务。

sentences.en: And that really means restricting what a single company can do.
sentences.zh: 这实际上意味着要限制某一家特定公司能做的事情。

sentences.en: NVIDIA, that's a company you cover.
sentences.zh: 英伟达，那是你负责报道的公司。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 没错，绝对是。

sentences.en: I mean, in the age of AI, NVIDIA makes the most powerful chips to develop artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在人工智能时代，英伟达制造了开发人工智能最强大的芯片。

sentences.en: They have a 90% market share in that marketplace for a reason.
sentences.zh: 他们在该市场拥有90%的份额是有原因的。

sentences.en: It's because they began developing this technology more than a decade before anybody else.
sentences.zh: 那是因为他们比任何人都早了十多年开始开发这项技术。

sentences.en: And conventional wisdom in Washington, going back to the first Trump administration,
sentences.zh: 华盛顿的传统观点，可以追溯到第一届特朗普政府时期，

sentences.en: when it came to American technology, was restrict, restrict, restrict everything that China has access to.
sentences.zh: 在涉及美国技术时，就是限制、限制、限制中国能够接触到的一切。

sentences.en: And the Trump administration came into office with a mission to shut down NVIDIA's shipments to China for the very reasons we just talked about.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府上台时，其使命正是出于我们刚才谈到的原因，要切断英伟达对中国的供应。

sentences.en: Let's make sure that the American AI companies stay ahead of the Chinese.
sentences.zh: 我们要确保美国的人工智能公司保持领先于中国。

sentences.en: And to do so, we'll shut off the lifeblood of developing that technology, and that lifeblood is NVIDIA.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们将切断开发该技术的命脉，而这条命脉就是英伟达。

sentences.en: But last week, Donald Trump did what he often does, which is defy Washington convention.
sentences.zh: 但上周，唐纳德·特朗普做了他常做的事，即无视华盛顿的传统。

sentences.en: He decided, actually, what we're going to do is we're going to make these AI chips available to the Chinese
sentences.zh: 他决定，实际上，我们要做的就是让这些人工智能芯片向中国开放，

sentences.en: because, paradoxically, we believe that will actually help American companies in the long run.
sentences.zh: 因为矛盾的是，我们认为从长远来看，这实际上会帮助美国公司。

sentences.en: And the big question is, like, is that going to prove to be true or not?
sentences.zh: 最大的问题是，这会被证明是正确的吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, we're going to try to unravel that argument in this conversation that giving China NVIDIA's AI chips
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们将在这次谈话中尝试理清这个论点：向中国提供英伟达的人工智能芯片，

sentences.en: somehow might benefit the U.S., which, as you say, is quite paradoxical in theory.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上可能对美国有利，正如你所说，这在理论上是非常矛盾的。

sentences.en: But I just want to talk about why this Trump reversal feels so big.
sentences.zh: 但我只是想谈谈为什么特朗普的这次反转感觉如此重大。

sentences.en: I mean, it not only undermines the Trump restriction approach that you just described so well, it undermines the idea that China is a national security threat to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这不仅破坏了你刚才描述得很好的特朗普限制方针，还破坏了“中国是对美国的国家安全威胁”这一观点，

sentences.en: that you would want to keep chips away from.
sentences.zh: 即你本想让中国无法获得芯片的理由。

sentences.en: And finally, it undermines this pretty central tenet of Trumpism when it comes to global trade, which is you don't embrace the view that free trade is the answer.
sentences.zh: 最后，它破坏了特朗普主义在国际贸易方面的一个核心原则，即你不能接受自由贸易是答案的观点。

sentences.en: This is not America firSt.
sentences.zh: 这不是“美国优先”。

sentences.en: No, this is a globalist approach.
sentences.zh: 不，这是一种全球主义的方法。

sentences.en: This is sell, sell, sell.
sentences.zh: 这是“卖、卖、卖”。

sentences.en: So what happened here?
sentences.zh: 那么这里发生了什么？

sentences.en: How and why is it that the president reversed himself on NVIDIA selling chips to China and, in the process, undermining all of these very natural Trump positions?
sentences.zh: 总统是如何以及为什么在英伟达向中国出售芯片的问题上反转自己的立场，并在此过程中破坏了所有这些非常自然的特朗普式立场？

sentences.en: What happened here is that the chief executive of the first company to be a $4 trillion company rolled up his sleeves and did the one thing he least enjoys, which is lobbying.
sentences.zh: 这里发生的事情是，这家市值达到4万亿美元的公司的首席执行官卷起袖子，做了他最不喜欢做的一件事，那就是游说。

sentences.en: So tell us about this CEO first and then the story of the sleeve rolling up in the lobbying.
sentences.zh: 那么先给我们讲讲这位首席执行官，然后再讲讲他卷起袖子游说的故事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: In a lot of ways, you know, what I'm experiencing is probably the ultimate American dream.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，你知道，我所经历的可能就是终极的美国梦。

sentences.en: Jensen Wong is an electrical engineer by training.
sentences.zh: 黄仁勋是一位受过专业训练的电气工程师。

sentences.en: He's an immigrant.
sentences.zh: 他是一位移民。

sentences.en: His family's from Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 他的家人来自台湾。

sentences.en: Come to the United States when I was seven years old, I guess eight years old, and having the opportunity to found a company with good friends.
sentences.zh: 我七岁，大概八岁时来到美国，有机会和好朋友一起创办了一家公司。

sentences.en: He was raised in Oregon and Kentucky before going to Oregon State, and he teamed up with a couple of engineers at a Denny's of all places.
sentences.zh: 他在俄勒冈州和肯塔基州长大，后来去了俄勒冈州立大学，并在一家丹尼餐厅（Denny's）与几位工程师组成了团队。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So we came here, right here to this Denny's, sat right back there, and the three of us decided to start the company.
sentences.zh: 所以我们来到这里，就在这家丹尼餐厅，坐在后面那里，我们三个人决定创办这家公司。

sentences.en: Frankly, I had no idea how to do it, and nor did they.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我不知道该怎么做，他们也不知道。

sentences.en: None of us knew how to do anything.
sentences.zh: 我们谁都不知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: And we started hashing out a plan for a new company that would make chips for video game developers three decades ago.
sentences.zh: 三十年前，我们开始为一家新公司制定计划，这家公司将为视频游戏开发者制造芯片。

sentences.en: And they focused exclusively on the video gaming industry for the better part of two decades.
sentences.zh: 在近二十年的时间里，他们专注于视频游戏行业。

sentences.en: And eventually, Jensen discovered that the chips that they were making were capable of doing computation simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 最终，黄仁勋发现他们制造的芯片能够同时进行计算。

sentences.en: And he saw within that computational power the potential to develop artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 他在这种计算能力中看到了开发人工智能的潜力。

sentences.en: And he began to pour billions of dollars into creating software that would control these chips
sentences.zh: 他开始投入数十亿美元开发控制这些芯片的软件，

sentences.en: and allow AI engineers to begin to build the artificial intelligence systems that we're now using today.
sentences.zh: 并让人工智能工程师开始构建我们今天正在使用的人工智能系统。

sentences.en: I mean, we would not be here today without NVIDIA.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，没有英伟达，我们今天就不会在这里。

sentences.en: There's a reason they have become such a gargantuan company and passed Apple, Microsoft, like all the other tech companies you've known and thought about for decades.
sentences.zh: 他们之所以成为如此庞大的公司，并超越了苹果、微软以及你几十年来所知和所想的所有其他科技公司，是有原因的。

sentences.en: NVIDIA just flew right past them in the span of two years.
sentences.zh: 英伟达在两年内就飞速超越了它们。

sentences.en: All because of this.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是因为这个。

sentences.en: So when AI has its lightning strike moment, the Biden administration begins to crack down on chip sales.
sentences.zh: 所以当人工智能迎来它的爆发时刻时，拜登政府开始打击芯片销售。

sentences.en: They say to NVIDIA, look, we're concerned about the speed and the processing power of these chips going to China
sentences.zh: 他们对英伟达说，看，我们担心这些芯片的速度和处理能力流向中国，

sentences.en: because, as we have read a lot about, we're concerned that AI can be used by the Chinese military to coordinate strikes or to develop advanced weaponry.
sentences.zh: 因为正如我们读到的那样，我们担心人工智能会被中国军方用于协调打击或开发先进武器。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It basically create a military advantage over the United States.
sentences.zh: 这基本上会在美国之上创造一种军事优势。

sentences.en: And that's a risk that seems for many intolerable.
sentences.zh: 对于许多人来说，这似乎是一个无法容忍的风险。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So in 2022, they say, we want you to throttle the performance of the chips you sell to China.
sentences.zh: 所以在2022年，他们说，我们希望你限制销往中国的芯片性能。

sentences.en: And by throttle, we mean reduce.
sentences.zh: 所谓的“限制”，我们的意思是降低。

sentences.en: Reduce the level of capabilities of the chips.
sentences.zh: 降低芯片的能力水平。

sentences.en: So NVIDIA does that.
sentences.zh: 所以英伟达照做了。

sentences.en: And the chip that they came up with eventually for exclusive sale in China is called the H20.
sentences.zh: 他们最终在中国独家销售的芯片被称为H20。

sentences.en: And it's just a variation of their chip that is less good.
sentences.zh: 它只是他们芯片的一个变体，性能较差。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Less good than what they sell elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 比他们在其他地方销售的要差。

sentences.en: You know, in the midst of all this, Wong is going to Washington for the first time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在这期间，黄仁勋第一次去了华盛顿。

sentences.en: He's going to the White House for the first time ever.
sentences.zh: 他有史以来第一次去了白宫。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a guy who's been in business for more than two decades at this point, nearly three decades.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个在商界已经超过二十年，快三十年的人。

sentences.en: He just hasn't gone to Washington and had to deal with political issues before.
sentences.zh: 他只是以前从未去过华盛顿，也不需要处理政治问题。

sentences.en: And he really doesn't enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 而且他真的不喜欢这样。

sentences.en: And he's all of a sudden realizing they need to open an office in Washington.
sentences.zh: 他突然意识到他们需要在华盛顿开设一个办事处。

sentences.en: They'd never done that.
sentences.zh: 他们以前从未这样做过。

sentences.en: And then, you know, come November, President Trump is elected to office.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，到了11月，特朗普总统当选了。

sentences.en: And they realize, oh, wait, we don't even have a Republican lobbyiSt.
sentences.zh: 他们意识到，哦，等等，我们甚至没有共和党的游说者。

sentences.en: So they hired their first Republican lobbyiSt.
sentences.zh: 于是他们雇佣了他们的第一位共和党游说者。

sentences.en: And the icing on the cake for Wong is when all the other CEOs in Silicon Valley show up at the inauguration and sit behind Trump and kind of do all that you need to do to get in his good graces at the start of his presidency,
sentences.zh: 对于黄仁勋来说，最糟糕的是，当硅谷的所有其他首席执行官都出现在就职典礼上，坐在特朗普身后，做着所有需要在总统任期开始时博取他好感的事情时，

sentences.en: Wong was somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 黄仁勋却在别的地方。

sentences.en: He was in, of all places, China.
sentences.zh: 他在中国，偏偏是在中国。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: Not the most politically adroit decision if you're trying to influence the incoming president.
sentences.zh: 如果你想影响即将上任的总统，这可不是最精明的政治决定。

sentences.en: All the other tech CEOs got the memo, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 听起来其他科技公司的首席执行官都收到了消息。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He did not.
sentences.zh: 他没有。

sentences.en: He did not get the memo.
sentences.zh: 他没有收到消息。

sentences.en: You know, meanwhile, at this point in time, Trump has tapped Howard Lutnick to be the head of commerce, which makes the decisions about what is sold abroad, essentially.
sentences.zh: 你知道，与此同时，特朗普已经任命霍华德·卢特尼克为商务部长，这基本上决定了什么产品可以销往国外。

sentences.en: It sets these restrictions.
sentences.zh: 它设定了这些限制。

sentences.en: I take a very jaundiced view of China.
sentences.zh: 我对中国持非常怀疑的态度。

sentences.en: I think they only care about themselves and seek to harm us.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们只关心自己，并寻求伤害我们。

sentences.en: And so we need to protect ourselves, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要保护自己，对吧？

sentences.en: And we need to stop helping them.
sentences.zh: 我们需要停止帮助他们。

sentences.en: He's gone before Congress in his cabinet hearing and said...
sentences.zh: 他在国会的内阁听证会上说……

sentences.en: NVIDIA's chips, which they bought tons of and they found their ways around it, drive their deep-seek model.
sentences.zh: 英伟达的芯片，他们买了很多，也找到了绕过限制的方法，驱动了他们的DeepSeek模型。

sentences.en: It's got to end.
sentences.zh: 这必须结束。

sentences.en: I'm going to get companies like NVIDIA to stop helping China develop AI.
sentences.zh: 我要让像英伟达这样的公司停止帮助中国开发人工智能。

sentences.en: If they're going to compete with us, let them compete.
sentences.zh: 如果他们要和我们竞争，就让他们竞争。

sentences.en: But stop using our tools to compete with us.
sentences.zh: 但别再用我们的工具来和我们竞争了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So suddenly, Wong's troubles are growing.
sentences.zh: 所以突然间，黄仁勋的麻烦越来越多了。

sentences.en: And as you've said, he doesn't seem to have a lot of inroads to the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，他似乎与特朗普政府没有太多交集。

sentences.en: He didn't even show up at the inauguration.
sentences.zh: 他甚至没有参加就职典礼。

sentences.en: He'd never even met Donald Trump before.
sentences.zh: 他以前甚至从未见过唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: So NVIDIA's put on notice that the shutdown was coming.
sentences.zh: 所以英伟达收到了即将被切断供应的通知。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And Howard Lutnick extends an invitation to Wong and says, look, if you want to make one last appeal,
sentences.zh: 霍华德·卢特尼克向黄仁勋发出了邀请，说，看，如果你想做最后一次申诉，

sentences.en: you can meet with the president in Mar-a-Lago on the sidelines of this $1 million candlelight dinner that President Trump was hosting as a political fundraiser.
sentences.zh: 你可以在海湖庄园特朗普总统举办的一场100万美元烛光晚宴的间隙与总统会面，那是一场政治筹款活动。

sentences.en: So Wong shows up, talks to the president, explains that the H20 chip that he's selling in China is not that powerful.
sentences.zh: 所以黄仁勋出现了，和总统谈了话，解释说他在中国销售的H20芯片并没有那么强大。

sentences.en: But when people in the administration are briefed on this conversation,
sentences.zh: 但当政府内部人员听取了这次谈话的简报时，

sentences.en: they feel like he's misled or undersold the capabilities of the chip because it actually has more power than Wong has let on.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得他误导或低估了芯片的能力，因为它的性能实际上比黄仁勋所说的要强。

sentences.en: And so they move to swiftly shut it down.
sentences.zh: 于是他们迅速采取行动切断了供应。

sentences.en: And NVIDIA gets a letter a few weeks later saying that they cannot sell H20s in China.
sentences.zh: 几周后，英伟达收到了一封信，称他们不能在中国销售H20芯片。

sentences.en: So he has completely misplayed things with the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 所以他在特朗普政府面前完全把事情搞砸了。

sentences.en: I mean, they were expecting about $15 million in sales of this chip by the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们预计到年底这款芯片的销售额约为1500万美元。

sentences.en: In China.
sentences.zh: 在中国。

sentences.en: That's a lot of money in China.
sentences.zh: 在中国那是一大笔钱。

sentences.en: And suddenly Trump is saying, no.
sentences.zh: 突然间特朗普说，不行。

sentences.en: No go.
sentences.zh: 没门。

sentences.en: You had mentioned that this is the story of Wong rolling up his sleeves and somehow overcoming this enormously consequential shutdown decision.
sentences.zh: 你曾提到这是黄仁勋卷起袖子，以某种方式克服了这一后果巨大的停售决定的故事。

sentences.en: So what is the story of how he pulls that off after this shutdown?
sentences.zh: 那么，在这次停售之后，他是如何做到这一点的故事是什么？

sentences.en: Wong's in need of a strategic reset.
sentences.zh: 黄仁勋需要进行战略重置。

sentences.en: And so he begins to look for allies within the administration.
sentences.zh: 于是他开始在政府内部寻找盟友。

sentences.en: And he finds one in David Sachs, who's the White House AI advisor and czar.
sentences.zh: 他找到了戴维·萨克斯（David Sachs），也就是白宫的AI顾问兼“沙皇”。

sentences.en: The two of them see eye to eye on the idea that restrictions are not the answer.
sentences.zh: 两人都认为，限制措施并非解决之道，这一点不谋而合。

sentences.en: Sachs is a venture capitalist and a libertarian at heart.
sentences.zh: 萨克斯是一位风险投资家，骨子里是个自由意志主义者。

sentences.en: And he begins to circulate and promote this idea that the best way for American companies in the AI world to succeed is to get as much of their technology around the world as fast as possible.
sentences.zh: 他开始四处传播并推销这样一个观点：美国AI公司要在全球取得成功，最好的办法就是尽快让它们的技术尽可能多地覆盖全球。

sentences.en: Just explain the theory, the philosophy there.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下这背后的理论和哲学。

sentences.en: Because it's clearly at odds with what the rest of the administration thinks.
sentences.zh: 因为它显然与政府其他人的想法相左。

sentences.en: It's at odds with what the rest of the administration thinks because it's like very much a Silicon Valley philosophy.
sentences.zh: 它之所以与政府其他人的想法相左，是因为这非常像是一种硅谷哲学。

sentences.en: It is that the more developers you have and the more people who use your product, the more committed they become to that technology.
sentences.zh: 那就是：你的开发者越多，使用你产品的人越多，他们对这项技术的忠诚度就越高。

sentences.en: And so the more they buy it on an each year basis, right?
sentences.zh: 这样他们每年都会购买，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, why do you buy another iPhone every year?
sentences.zh: 就像你为什么每年都要买一部新iPhone一样？

sentences.en: It's because you're used to the way the technology works.
sentences.zh: 因为你已经习惯了这种技术的工作方式。

sentences.en: It's the exact same philosophy.
sentences.zh: 哲学完全是一样的。

sentences.en: And so they're anticipating that China is going to challenge NVIDIA at some point with a chip maker of its own and say we have to sell as many NVIDIA chips abroad in the same way that Apple wants to sell as many iPhones abroad before people decide to buy an Android device.
sentences.zh: 所以他们预见到，中国迟早会用自己的芯片制造商挑战英伟达（NVIDIA），他们认为必须像苹果希望在人们决定购买安卓设备之前，尽可能多地向海外销售iPhone一样，向海外销售尽可能多的英伟达芯片。

sentences.en: Dominance leads to American supremacy in AI.
sentences.zh: 主导地位带来美国在AI领域的霸权。

sentences.en: Don't restrict it.
sentences.zh: 不要限制它。

sentences.en: That's basically the argument.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是他们的论点。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: We will stay further ahead if we sell more chips than if we restrict chip sales either in China or anywhere else in the world.
sentences.zh: 如果我们销售更多的芯片，而不是限制在中国或世界其他任何地方的芯片销售，我们将保持领先地位。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, how does that argument go with the rest of the administration?
sentences.zh: 那么，这个论点在政府内部反响如何？

sentences.en: With time, they begin to make headway on this in large part because one of the focal points of the administration is this trip that Donald Trump makes to the Middle East in May.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，他们开始在这方面取得进展，很大程度上是因为政府关注的焦点之一是唐纳德·特朗普在五月份对中东的访问。

sentences.en: And one of the things that Donald Trump wants out of this trip is deals, deals, deals.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普此行想要的东西之一就是交易，交易，还是交易。

sentences.en: And so in the run-up to that trip, they began to go to work on a giant chip sale to the United Arab Emirates.
sentences.zh: 因此，在访问前夕，他们开始着手促成一笔向阿拉伯联合酋长国出售巨额芯片的交易。

sentences.en: And that is a capstone of this trip that Donald Trump makes across the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 这也是唐纳德·特朗普此次中东之行的重头戏。

sentences.en: President Trump's visit to the Middle East, unleashing a wave of AI deal-making,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统的中东之行，掀起了一波AI交易浪潮，

sentences.en: the Trump administration clearing a path for Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates to pursue their artificial intelligence ambitions as deals with Trump...
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府为沙特阿拉伯和阿拉伯联合酋长国追求其人工智能雄心扫清了道路，因为与特朗普的交易……

sentences.en: It culminates in the United Arab Emirates where they announced the sale of about 500,000 chips.
sentences.zh: 最终在阿拉伯联合酋长国达成，他们宣布了约50万颗芯片的销售计划。

sentences.en: They're going to build the largest data centers outside of the United States in their Emirates.
sentences.zh: 他们将在阿联酋建立美国以外最大的数据中心。

sentences.en: And how does Wong and NVIDIA fit into this?
sentences.zh: 黄仁勋（Wong）和英伟达是如何融入其中的？

sentences.en: They're all NVIDIA chips.
sentences.zh: 它们全都是英伟达的芯片。

sentences.en: And Sachs is the one who's at the negotiating table who puts this deal together.
sentences.zh: 而萨克斯正是坐在谈判桌前促成这笔交易的人。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: It's an honor to be here.
sentences.zh: 能来到这里是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: What a great place.
sentences.zh: 真是个好地方。

sentences.en: And the president is there on his last day of his trip to praise this deal and highlight it before flying home.
sentences.zh: 总统在访问的最后一天出席了会议，在飞回国之前赞扬并强调了这笔交易。

sentences.en: NVIDIA is investing, and I see my friend is here.
sentences.zh: 英伟达正在投资，我看到我的朋友也在这里。

sentences.en: Jensen, that's very good, wherever you may be.
sentences.zh: 黄仁勋，做得非常好，无论你在哪里。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, because he's...
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，因为他……

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So Wong gives Trump a major foreign deal that means a lot to Trump.
sentences.zh: 所以黄仁勋给了特朗普一笔重大的外国交易，这对特朗普意义重大。

sentences.en: Wong gives Trump a win, and what does Trump love?
sentences.zh: 黄仁勋给了特朗普一场胜利，而特朗普喜欢什么？

sentences.en: He loves winning, and he loves winners.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢赢，他也喜欢赢家。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, he recognizes in Wong a U.S.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，他在黄仁勋身上看到了一个美国的

sentences.en: winner.
sentences.zh: 赢家。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Where is Jensen, by the way?
sentences.zh: 顺便问一下，黄仁勋在哪里？

sentences.en: Where is he?
sentences.zh: 他在哪儿？

sentences.en: He's standing here.
sentences.zh: 他就站在那儿。

sentences.en: Where is he?
sentences.zh: 他在哪儿？

sentences.en: I just saw Beth.
sentences.zh: 我刚看到贝丝（Beth）了。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Jensen.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，黄仁勋。

sentences.en: I mean, Tim Cook isn't here, but you are.
sentences.zh: 我是说，蒂姆·库克（Tim Cook）没来，但你来了。

sentences.en: What a job you've done.
sentences.zh: 你干得真漂亮。

sentences.en: And Wong decides this is a green light to go for the ultimate win, which is getting sales back in China.
sentences.zh: 黄仁勋认为这是一个绿灯，可以去争取最终的胜利，那就是恢复对中国的销售。

sentences.en: Getting the shutdown on the sales of these chips to China eliminated.
sentences.zh: 取消对这些芯片销往中国的禁令。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对。

sentences.en: And he knows he needs to grease the wheels and get support from Trump for that.
sentences.zh: 他知道他需要打通关节，并为此获得特朗普的支持。

sentences.en: And one of the things that NVIDIA does in the midst of all of this is promise to spend $500 billion on manufacturing chips and other AI products in the United States.
sentences.zh: 英伟达在此期间所做的事情之一，就是承诺在美国投资5000亿美元用于制造芯片和其他AI产品。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Right, because as we know, most of these chips were made overseas in Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为我们知道，这些芯片大多是在海外的台湾制造的。

sentences.en: He's saying, I can bring those here.
sentences.zh: 他说，我可以把它们带到这里来。

sentences.en: We can start making them here.
sentences.zh: 我们可以开始在这里制造它们。

sentences.en: American jobs, music to Trump's ears.
sentences.zh: 美国就业机会，这对特朗普来说简直是天籁之音。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: This is exactly what the president likes to hear.
sentences.zh: 这正是总统喜欢听到的。

sentences.en: And all of this builds up to a meeting at the White House in mid-July, where Wong goes into the Oval Office and begins to make this argument, which is, look,
sentences.zh: 所有这些都促成了7月中旬在白宫的一次会议，黄仁勋走进椭圆形办公室，开始提出这个论点，那就是，你看，

sentences.en: let us sell into China.
sentences.zh: 让我们向中国销售吧。

sentences.en: It will strengthen our business and strengthen American AI to do so.
sentences.zh: 这样做将加强我们的业务，并加强美国的AI实力。

sentences.en: And Trump, eventually, at the end of the meeting, agrees.
sentences.zh: 最终，在会议结束时，特朗普同意了。

sentences.en: And you have this massive reversal with Wong walking out of the Oval Office, elated that he's had this huge, colossal win.
sentences.zh: 于是出现了这种巨大的反转，黄仁勋走出椭圆形办公室时，因为取得了这场巨大的、史诗般的胜利而欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because Trump has quite literally reversed himself on something quite central to his entire political and economic identity.
sentences.zh: 因为特朗普实际上在对他整个政治和经济身份的核心问题上推翻了自己的立场。

sentences.en: This is the president who started the crackdown on China to begin with.
sentences.zh: 正是这位总统最初发起了对中国的打压。

sentences.en: And now he's the one who's loosening the reins for NVIDIA and AI chip makers so that they can plow right into China, which raises this enormous question.
sentences.zh: 而现在，他却成了那个为英伟达和AI芯片制造商松绑的人，让他们可以长驱直入中国市场，这引发了一个巨大的问题。

sentences.en: What are the repercussions of this going to be?
sentences.zh: 这会带来什么后果？

sentences.en: And that's what we'll talk about after the break.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们休息后要讨论的内容。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰（Benjamin Poulin）。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森（Mark Ronson）。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》（The Reframers），这是一个关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在夜店当DJ的黑胶唱片时代，你每天都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个活生生的、充满50年历史精美文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Lowe.
sentences.zh: 我是韦娜·洛（Wena Lowe）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》游戏。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基（Sam Mazursky），我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”（promesthesia）的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com/games 开始今天的游戏吧。

sentences.en: So, Chip, let's really talk through the implications of Trump's reversal.
sentences.zh: 那么，奇普（Chip），让我们深入探讨一下特朗普立场反转的影响。

sentences.en: And as we've established, it's a reversal on all kinds of Trump's core principles.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所确定的，这是对特朗普各种核心原则的反转。

sentences.en: America first, globalists are bad, China is a big, serious threat.
sentences.zh: 美国优先，全球主义者是坏人，中国是一个严重的大威胁。

sentences.en: How do you think he ultimately comes to terms with this argument that's been made by Wong and Sachs that selling these chips to China is somehow not a betrayal of all those things and that it's somehow good for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你认为他最终是如何接受黄仁勋和萨克斯提出的这个论点的：向中国出售这些芯片在某种程度上并不背叛所有这些原则，而且在某种程度上对美国有利，

sentences.en: and not better for China?
sentences.zh: 而不是对中国更有利？

sentences.en: In large part, the president came around on this because of the boogeyman that Wong and Sachs had created in Huawei.
sentences.zh: 很大程度上，总统之所以转变态度，是因为黄仁勋和萨克斯在华为身上制造了一个“妖怪”。

sentences.en: Giant telecom company in China.
sentences.zh: 中国的一家巨型电信公司。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And just remind us why Huawei is a boogeyman.
sentences.zh: 提醒我们一下，为什么华为是个“妖怪”？

sentences.en: Huawei is a boogeyman and has kind of really been a boogeyman for Trump himself going back to the first administration.
sentences.zh: 华为是个“妖怪”，而且从第一任期开始，对特朗普本人来说，它就一直是个“妖怪”。

sentences.en: It is China's crown jewel of technology.
sentences.zh: 它是中国科技界的皇冠明珠。

sentences.en: It is a company capable of designing smartphones, cars, telecom.
sentences.zh: 它是一家有能力设计智能手机、汽车、电信设备的公司。

sentences.en: And it's a company that when Wong talks about it,
sentences.zh: 而且当黄仁勋谈到它时，

sentences.en: his eyes widen because he's petrified that if Huawei is able to begin making gains in the AI chips that it makes and they become as performative as those that NVIDIA offers,
sentences.zh: 他的眼睛会睁大，因为他非常害怕，如果华为能够开始在它制造的AI芯片上取得进展，并且它们的性能变得和英伟达提供的一样好，

sentences.en: that it will just begin to squeeze NVIDIA out of global sales.
sentences.zh: 那么它就会开始把英伟达挤出全球销售市场。

sentences.en: And there's this philosophy in tech companies, particularly inside chip companies, that the more they sell,
sentences.zh: 科技公司，尤其是芯片公司内部有一种哲学，那就是卖得越多，

sentences.en: the more money they make and the more money they can plow into research and development to make their technology better, faster, higher performance.
sentences.zh: 赚的钱就越多，投入到研发中的钱也就越多，从而使他们的技术更好、更快、性能更高。

sentences.en: And so Sachs and Wong's philosophy here is if we don't sell to China, we're just leaving money on the table.
sentences.zh: 所以萨克斯和黄仁勋的哲学是：如果我们不卖给中国，我们只是在白白放弃利润。

sentences.en: And the Chinese are going to be the ones who are able to make the money and plow that money into research and development.
sentences.zh: 而中国人将成为能够赚钱并将这些钱投入到研发中的人。

sentences.en: Their own future chips.
sentences.zh: 他们自己未来的芯片。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And they're going to leapfrog us.
sentences.zh: 他们会超越我们。

sentences.en: And for the Trump administration, they're sympathetic to this point of view.
sentences.zh: 对于特朗普政府来说，他们对这种观点表示同情。

sentences.en: You have to remember, China has the Belt and Road Initiative.
sentences.zh: 你必须记住，中国有“一带一路”倡议。

sentences.en: One of the things that NVIDIA has also talked about in the course of this is the possibility that China could create Huawei data centers around the world.
sentences.zh: 英伟达在此过程中谈到的事情之一，是中国可能在全球范围内建立华为数据中心的可能性。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden, instead of having American data centers and running AI on American technology, you have the risk of running it on Chinese technology.
sentences.zh: 然后突然之间，你不再使用美国的数据中心和运行在美国技术上的AI，而是面临着运行在中国技术上的风险。

sentences.en: And just to explain what you're saying, One Belt, One Road, China's infrastructure program,
sentences.zh: 简单解释一下你所说的，“一带一路”，中国的基建项目，

sentences.en: where it deploys its money and sometimes its expertise to help developing economies get where they want to be when it comes to energy or roadways, solar.
sentences.zh: 它投入资金，有时也投入专业知识，帮助发展中经济体在能源、道路、太阳能方面达到他们想要的目标。

sentences.en: The idea is that Huawei could help China layer on top of that AI technology around the world.
sentences.zh: 其想法是，华为可以帮助中国在全球范围内叠加AI技术。

sentences.en: So the entire global AI economy could suddenly be operating on Chinese systems, not American ones.
sentences.zh: 所以整个全球AI经济可能突然间都在中国系统上运行，而不是美国系统上。

sentences.en: That's the fear.
sentences.zh: 这就是恐惧所在。

sentences.en: That's the fear.
sentences.zh: 这就是恐惧所在。

sentences.en: And there's a window right now where NVIDIA is ahead of Huawei in terms of the quality of the chips it makes, in terms of its ability to make those chips.
sentences.zh: 目前有一个窗口期，英伟达在芯片质量和制造能力方面都领先于华为。

sentences.en: And NVIDIA has argued, we should take advantage of that window.
